tex_content.html:
Theorem
[Homotopy type of a $K(G,1)$ is unique] ↗ def:k-g-1-space ↗ prop:homomorphism-to-kg1-realized-by-map 1. ch1:1B.8\group Fundamental Group

The homotopy type of a CW complex $K(G,1)$ is determined by $G$.

Proof

\sketch An isomorphism of fundamental groups is realized in both directions by the next proposition. The composites induce identity homomorphisms and are therefore homotopic to the identity by its uniqueness statement.

□
